data.rationale: The proposal gets the core sequence right (Permits tab, search, select Katmai, enter date, Check Availability), but it has no parameters and hardcodes the location, date and search text. It also omits the group-size/guests step and the typed values, so it can't be generalized to other locations or dates without more information.
